question: The most appropriate synonym of the word ‘linear’ is:
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. "**Continuous**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Linear**: (रेखीय) - Arranged in or extending along a straight or nearly straight line

 
 
• **Example**: The city planning committee is considering a linear park through downtown.
 
 
 
• **Continuous**: (निरंतर) - Forming an unbroken whole; without interruption
 
 
• **Example**: The continuous hum of the refrigerator was annoying.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Continuous**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ambiguous: (अस्पष्ट)** - Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning
 
• **Rapid: (तेज़) **- Happening in a short time or at a great rate
 
• **Variable: (परिवर्तनशील)** - Not consistent or having a fixed pattern; liable to change
